source.title: Royal Mail Online Prices — valid from 5 October 2026
source.buyingChannel: Royal Mail Click & Drop / online guide; not business-account or counter prices
source.note: Price transcription is verified against the dated guide. Every rate is disabled, available=false and contentsApproved=false; country/service operational eligibility is not established. Grouped Gulf rows use the published Rest of World Zone 1 price once. UK prices include VAT as published; international tables state UK VAT at zero rate. Published collection fee is separate; destination duties, taxes, handling and other surcharges are not calculated.
